en.answer:
In that case, the monsters targeted for its effect are unable to be equipped and are sent to the Graveyard.

(Furthermore, the targeted monsters do not enter the field and are sent directly to the Graveyard)
en.question: If <<5432>> is activated in a chain to the effect of <<9841>> that equips it with banished monsters, so that it is flipped to face-down Defense Position when its effect resolves, how does its effect resolve?
en.title: If <<5432>> is activated in a chain to the effect of <<9841>> that equips it with banished monsters, so that it is flipped to face-down Defense Position when its effect resolves, how does its effect resolve?

ja.answer:
その場合、「<<9841>>」の効果の対象として選択された『ゲームから除外されている自分の魚族・海竜族・水族モンスター』は装備させる事はできず、墓地へ送られる事になります。
（なお、対象のモンスターはフィールドに出る事はなく、そのまま墓地へ送られる事になります。）
